positive_face_definition: The physical positive/non-reverse tabletop face has STL +Z towards the camera. For the confirmed tabletop reverse, STL +Z (= documented workpiece +Z) points into the table and STL -Z faces the camera.
grasp_point_definition: Operator-selected convenient convex tab: the upper-left end in the confirmed tabletop-reverse RGB view. It is a CAD surface landmark expressed in documented workpiece coordinates (X+, Y+, Z-).
table_reverse_yaw_selection_description: The confirmed tabletop reverse has one physical yaw. Use reverse yaw initial 2: documented object +X points to the raised outer tab (left in the confirmed RGB view), +Y points upward, and +Z points into the table. ICP quality scores may not rotate these documented axes.
